entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Ooh, what a beautiful sight.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: The skyscrapers are now under[n]our feet... Doesn't that give[n]you a sense of superiority?
Superiority?
Such a delicious thrill...[clr 27]
That's so petty.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Yes... Maybe that stems from[n]my inferiority complex from[n]being from the countryside.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: For some reason, when you[n]say it like that, it makes [n]you sound like a villain...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Ugh, come on!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: At least let me enjoy [n]what it feels like [n]to be a ruler!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: When I'm at street level,[n]all the tall buildings make[n]me feel like Tokyo is a prison.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But when I look down from[n]here, it's surprisingly huge.[n]I forget how big it actually is.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...All the members are still[n]trapped in their tiny world.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: That's why I need to help them[n]realize that there are more [n]important things than destiny.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: And since I realized that, [n]I have to be the one [n]to help them...!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Okay... I have to do something!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But for now, I'm going to [n]immerse myself in the feeling[n]of being a ruler of this city...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: And I'll do so by your side.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I had a great time today.[n]...This is to say thanks [n]for always encouraging me.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: May the light guide you...!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Okay, let's return to the city...
